Hectic Highway is the second stage in the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. This stage can be unlocked by evolving
Alternatively, Hectic Highway can be unlocked in the

Contra Force, rev your jetbikes – its time to drive fast, and fire faster. Red falcon traitors are invading the C-1 Highway for some treasonable reason, and we need you to defend our crucial infrastructure.

, this stage has a unique mechanic where the stage itself scrolls to the right, independent of the player's movement, creating an impression of the character moving along the highway and enemies appearing to be "chasing" the player. While playing in Inverse mode with "Visually Invert Stages" enabled, the stage will instead scroll to the left. Aside from its visual effects, dropped items and destructibles are directly affected by the scrolling effect, moving with the stage. Pickups and treasure chests must be "caught" while they are still in front the player and failing to do so results in the items getting left behind. Attempting to move opposite to the stage's movement in order to go after items will be futile as the pace of the scrolling effect counteracts the character's own movement, preventing passed by items from being reached. After a set point, the stage resets, which allows items left behind to be gathered.

Although to a lesser extent, the scrolling effect affects enemies as well, with the stage tugging all enemies slightly as it scrolls, causing enemies to stutter as they oppose the drag with their own movement.
